propositions: Documentation incorrectly claims bug ticket types are gate-exempt with runner=exempt, when they are actually reviewed under the bug tier
Only session_log, code_review, and identity types are truly gate-exempt; bug types receive light advisory review under the bug review tier but are never blocked
The code correctly implements bug review tier behavior, but docs/plan-review-gate.md and review_plan docstring contain stale statements claiming bugs bypass review
The claim-time CLI exemption for bugs (no signed attestation required) is being conflated with the gate review exemption, creating confusion about two separate exemption axes
Acceptance criteria require updating documentation to remove false bug exemption claims and clarify that only session_log/code_review/identity are gate-exempt
